prereg.selection_rule: Highest validation balanced accuracy among non-baseline strategies with validation coverage >= 0.90 and >= 300 forecasts (min(300, 0.9 x validation slots)); tie-break by validation mean IC.
test_hypotheses: H2: test gross directional return > 0 (Newey-West, alpha 0.05)
H4: test 3-class Brier score of the model < climatology Brier
H5: test touch-probability Brier < climatology Brier for every target

rev_ma_30.hypothesis: Price reverts toward its 30-min moving average.

rev_ma_60.hypothesis: Price reverts toward its 60-min moving average.

rev_ma_240.hypothesis: Price reverts toward its 240-min moving average.

rev_ma_1440.hypothesis: Price reverts toward its 1440-min moving average.

brk_fade_60.hypothesis: Break of the 60-min high/low fails (false breakout).

brk_fade_240.hypothesis: Break of the 240-min high/low fails (false breakout).

brk_fade_1440.hypothesis: Break of the 1440-min high/low fails (false breakout).

range_follow_240.hypothesis: Price near the top of its 240-min range keeps rising.

range_follow_1440.hypothesis: Price near the top of its 1440-min range keeps rising.

rv_mom_10.hypothesis: 10-min moves on high relative volume continue.

rv_rev_10.hypothesis: 10-min moves on high relative volume overshoot and revert.

rv_mom_60.hypothesis: 60-min moves on high relative volume continue.

rv_rev_60.hypothesis: 60-min moves on high relative volume overshoot and revert.

vol_spike_rev.hypothesis: Volume spikes (rel. volume >3x) mark exhaustion: fade the 10-min move.

ofi_follow_10.hypothesis: Aggressive buying over 10 min predicts further rise.

ofi_fade_10.hypothesis: Aggressive buying over 10 min exhausts and reverses.

ofi_follow_30.hypothesis: Aggressive buying over 30 min predicts further rise.

ofi_fade_30.hypothesis: Aggressive buying over 30 min exhausts and reverses.

ofi_follow_60.hypothesis: Aggressive buying over 60 min predicts further rise.

ofi_fade_60.hypothesis: Aggressive buying over 60 min exhausts and reverses.

ofi_absorption.hypothesis: Price falling despite taker buying = absorption (bullish), and vice versa.

volreg_switch.hypothesis: High short/long vol ratio -> reversal; calm -> momentum.

hv_reversal.hypothesis: Reversal strength scales with volatility expansion.

ar1_adaptive.hypothesis: Per-coin AR(1) of 10-min returns (7-day window) applied to the last 5-min move.

regime_gated_mom.hypothesis: Momentum only works when BTC's 24h trend is up.

regime_gated_rev.hypothesis: Short-term reversal only in high-volatility BTC regimes.

breadth_regime.hypothesis: One-sided markets (breadth>70% or <30%) trend; mixed markets revert.

btc_lead_5.hypothesis: Alts catch up to BTC's 5-min move (beta-adjusted lead-lag).

btc_lead_10.hypothesis: Alts catch up to BTC's 10-min move (beta-adjusted lead-lag).

btc_lead_30.hypothesis: Alts catch up to BTC's 30-min move (beta-adjusted lead-lag).

btc_lead_60.hypothesis: Alts catch up to BTC's 60-min move (beta-adjusted lead-lag).

eth_lead_10.hypothesis: Coins catch up to ETH's 10-min move.

eth_lead_60.hypothesis: Coins catch up to ETH's 60-min move.

btc_beta_mom.hypothesis: BTC's 60-min trend transmits to high-beta coins.

xs_rel_rev_60.hypothesis: Coins that out/under-performed the universe over 60 min revert.

liq_shock_rev.hypothesis: Forced-liquidation overshoot: >3-sigma 10-min move on >2x volume with one-sided taker flow reverts.

exhaustion.hypothesis: A 4h trend with fading volume (rel. vol <0.8) is exhausted and reverses.

dispersion_rev.hypothesis: Reversal is stronger when cross-sectional dispersion is high.

breadth_divergence.hypothesis: A coin moving against market breadth reverts toward the crowd.

calm_drift.hypothesis: In compressed volatility, the EWMA drift persists.

us_session_mom.hypothesis: Momentum persists only in the high-activity 13-21 UTC session.

ar_pooled.hypothesis: Pooled AR(3) on standardized lagged horizon returns.

ridge_reversal_set.hypothesis: Ridge on short-term reversal features only.

huber_all.hypothesis: Robust (Huber-loss) linear regression on all features.

lgbm_reg_huber.hypothesis: LightGBM with Huber loss (robust to fat tails).

ens_family_equal.hypothesis: Equal-weight average of 8 family-representative rule signals.

ens_top5_ic.hypothesis: Average of the 5 rules with the best positive training correlation.

ens_stack_ridge.hypothesis: Ridge-stacked combination of all rule signals.

ens_ml_avg.hypothesis: Average of ridge, LightGBM and logistic model forecasts.

regime_switch.hypothesis: Regime-dependent choice of rule (BTC trend x volatility).
